title: [Enhancement/Leaderboard]: Interactive Contributor Rank Delta Indicator & Tier Progress Bar
body:
## Problem
Leaderboard entries show current points and rank, but contributors cannot visualize how close they are to the next NSoC rank tier or see recent point progression clearly at a glance.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/rank-tier-progress.css`:
   - Horizontal slim progress bar inside contributor cards/rows showing percentage toward next milestone tier (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Legend) plus rank delta pill (`+2`, `-1`, `NEW`).
2. Create modular helper `assets/js/rank-tier-progress.js`:
   - Implement `computeTierProgress(points, tiers)` returning current tier, next tier name, points remaining, and clamped percentage (`0` to `100`).
   - Compute rank delta safely from cached snapshot comparisons in `localStorage`.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/CSS3, zero dependencies, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-rank-tier-progress.js` verifying boundary score tiers, max-tier capping at 100%, and delta formatting.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tier progress bar accurately reflects progress toward the next contributor tier.
- [ ] Max-tier contributors display a completed 100% bar without overflow.
- [ ] Rank delta computation handles new contributors safely.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-rank-tier-progress.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected files (`leaderboard.html`, `games-registry.js`) remain untouched.

title: [Enhancement/UI]: Interactive Footer Network & Offline Cache Status Badge with Sync Timestamp

## Architectural Scope & Requirements

3. Pure Vanilla JS/CSS3, zero dependencies, zero emojis.
4. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-network-status-badge.js` validating online/offline transitions and timestamp formatting.

## Acceptance Criteria

title: [Enhancement/Audio]: Web Audio Fade-In & Fade-Out Smooth Ramp Controller on Game Modal Open and Close
body:
## Problem
Abruptly starting or cutting off Web Audio API oscillators and master gain nodes when opening or closing game modals causes unpleasant speaker pops and clicks.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/audio-ramp-ui.css`:
   - Optional toggle indicator in audio preferences for "Smooth Audio Fade Transitions".
2. Create modular controller `assets/js/audio-ramp.js`:
   - Implement `AudioRampController` wrapping `GainNode.gain` transitions using `exponentialRampToValueAtTime` / `linearRampToValueAtTime` over configurable fade windows (`150ms` default).
   - Guard against `AudioContext` `0` value exceptions on exponential ramps (clamping floor to `0.0001`).
   - Cancel pending scheduled values (`cancelScheduledValues`) safely when rapid open/close toggles occur.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API, zero external packages, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-audio-ramp.js` verifying ramp scheduling calls, zero-floor safety clamping, and rapid-toggle cancellation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Opening or closing audio channels ramps gain smoothly without speaker popping artifacts.
- [ ] Rapid open/close sequences cancel overlapping schedules cleanly.
- [ ] Zero-value exponential ramp edge cases are safely clamped.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-audio-ramp.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected files remain untouched.

title: [Feature/VFX]: Interactive 2D Gray-Scott Reaction-Diffusion Turing Pattern Canvas Lab
body:

## Architectural Scope & Requirements

2. Create modular PDE engine `assets/js/reaction-diffusion.js`:
   - Implement 2D Gray-Scott equations on dual `Float32Array` ping-pong grids (`A` and `B` chemical concentrations) with 3x3 weighted Laplacian convolution stencil.
   - Clamp concentrations `[0, 1]` and map output to customizable color ramps using direct `ImageData` pixel buffer writes for 60 FPS throughput.
   - Support mouse click/drag seeding of chemical `B` directly onto the canvas.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas `ImageData`, zero external math/shader packages, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-reaction-diffusion.js` validating Laplacian stencil weights, concentration clamping, and single-step chemical diffusion stability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Gray-Scott PDE simulation evolves organic Turing patterns smoothly at interactive framerates.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Interactive Software 3D Wireframe Polyhedron & Perspective Projection Canvas Engine
body:
## Problem
Classic 1980s arcade vector cabinets (like Battlezone, Elite, and Star Wars) achieved 3D graphics without GPUs using pure CPU 3D rotation matrices and perspective projection. ArcadeVerse lacks an educational and interactive software 3D projection engine.

   - Implement pure JS 3D vector/matrix math (`rotateX`, `rotateY`, `rotateZ`, cross/dot products, perspective divide `x' = x * fov / (z + dist)`).
   - Implement backface culling via face normal dot product and Painter's Algorithm z-sorting for flat-shaded mode.
   - Support interactive mouse/touch drag rotation with angular momentum inertia.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas API (strictly NO WebGL/Three.js), zero dependencies, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-software-3d-engine.js` verifying rotation matrix orthogonality, perspective projection math, and backface normal culling.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Polyhedra rotate smoothly in 3D space using pure 2D Canvas line/polygon calls.
- [ ] Backface culling and Painter's algorithm z-sorting render cleanly without inverted faces.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Procedural 16-Step Web Audio Drum Machine & Polyrhythmic Sequencer Studio

   - Synthesize all percussion instruments strictly via Web Audio API nodes (zero `.wav`/`.mp3` samples):
     - Kick: sine oscillator rapid pitch envelope `150Hz -> 40Hz`.
     - Snare: white-noise buffer through high-pass filter + short triangle body tone.
     - Closed/Open Hi-Hat: 6 detuned square oscillators through high-pass filter.
     - Clap: multi-burst band-passed noise envelope.
   - Implement Web Audio lookahead scheduler (`scheduleAheadTime` + `setInterval` timer) ensuring rock-solid rhythmic timing independent of UI frame drops.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API, zero external audio libraries, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-drum-sequencer.js` verifying step timing math, swing offset calculation, and pattern preset serialization.

3. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API, zero external libraries, zero emojis.

   - Resolve collisions via impulse equations including rotational torque (`r x J`) and positional Baumgarte stabilization to prevent sinking/jitter.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas, zero external physics engines (strictly NO Matter.js/Box2D), zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-rigid-body-sandbox.js` verifying SAT overlap detection, impulse conservation bounds, and non-NaN rotation updates.

## Acceptance Criteria

body:
## Problem
Real-time fractal zoom explorers showcase mathematical beauty and procedural coloring algorithms, offering an engaging creative graphics toy that ArcadeVerse currently lacks.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/fractal-explorer.css`:
   - Split or toggleable Canvas viewport with HUD controls for Mode (`Mandelbrot` vs `Julia Set`), Max Iterations (`50`–`500`), Color Palette (`Electric Neon`, `Magma`, `Cyber Ice`, `Monochrome`), Palette Cycle toggle, and Reset Zoom button.
2. Create modular renderer `assets/js/fractal-explorer.js`:
   - Compute complex escape-time iterations `z = z^2 + c` with smooth continuous coloring (`mu = n + 1 - log(log(|z|)) / log(2)`) eliminating ugly color banding.
   - Implement progressive/chunked row rendering or Web Worker offload so zooming and panning never freeze the main UI thread.
   - Support click-to-zoom-in, right-click/Shift-click zoom-out, and interactive mouse-linked Julia constant `c` preview.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas `ImageData`, zero external math libraries, zero emojis.
4. Add automated test `scripts/test-fractal-explorer.js` verifying known Mandelbrot interior vs exterior points (`(0,0)` escapes=false, `(2,2)` escapes=true), smooth escape normalization, and viewport coordinate mapping.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Mandelbrot and Julia fractals render smoothly with band-free logarithmic color gradients.
- [ ] Zooming and panning keep the UI responsive without freezing the browser tab.
- [ ] Palette cycling animates color offsets smoothly at 60 FPS.
- [ ] Standalone test `scripts/test-fractal-explorer.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected files remain untouched.

title: [Theme/UI]: 1983 MSX2 & PC-9801 Japanese Dithered 16-Color Cyber Aesthetic Theme Studio
body:
## Problem
Classic 1980s Japanese home computers like the MSX2 and NEC PC-9801 pioneered distinctive 16-color ordered Bayer dithering gradients and crisp double-lined ASCII/pixel window frames that give retro cyber adventure games an iconic look.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/theme-pc98-dither.css`:
   - Pure CSS `conic-gradient` / `repeating-linear-gradient` ordered 4x4 checkerboard dithering pattern backgrounds (zero external PNG textures).
   - 16-color NEC PC-98 palette variables (Deep Navy `#080828`, Phosphor Cyan `#44FFEE`, Warm Amber `#FFAA22`, Crisp Ivory `#F4F4EE`, Pixel Magenta `#EE4499`).
   - Sharp double-pixel dialog box frames and inset status counters.
2. Create modular studio controller `assets/js/theme-pc98-dither.js`:
   - Register theme under ID `pc98-msx2-dither` with toggleable "400-Line CRT Interlace" subtle scanline filter.
   - Persist theme and interlace option in `localStorage`.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/CSS3, zero external fonts or images, zero emojis.
4. Add standalone test `scripts/test-theme-pc98-dither.js` validating palette token completeness, registration, and interlace state persistence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Ordered CSS dithering patterns and double-lined retro frames render cleanly without external assets.
- [ ] Contrast between ivory/cyan text and deep navy panels exceeds WCAG AA readability.
- [ ] Theme selection and interlace toggle persist across page reloads.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-theme-pc98-dither.js` passes under `node`.

title: [Feature/VFX]: Interactive 2D Lissajous Curve & Harmonograph Phase-Shift Oscillograph Canvas
body:
## Problem
Vector arcade scopes and analog oscilloscopes produce hypnotic parametric Lissajous figures and decaying harmonograph pendulum loops when sinusoidal frequencies interact, providing a stunning audio-visual oscilloscope sandbox that ArcadeVerse lacks.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/lissajous-oscillograph.css`:
   - Phosphor scope canvas frame with controls for X/Y Frequency Ratios (`1:1`, `2:3`, `3:4`, `5:4`, custom sliders), Phase Delta speed, Pendulum Damping (`Harmonograph` mode), and Phosphor Trail persistence.
2. Create modular visualizer `assets/js/lissajous-oscillograph.js`:
   - Evaluate parametric equations `x(t) = A*sin(a*t + delta)*e^(-d1*t)` and `y(t) = B*sin(b*t)*e^(-d2*t)` across smooth sub-stepped curves.
   - Render glowing phosphor beam lines with additive composite blending and optional live Web Audio dual-sine tone preview matched to the frequency ratio.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas/Web Audio API, zero dependencies, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-lissajous-oscillograph.js` verifying parametric coordinate bounds, exponential damping convergence, and ratio normalization.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth glowing Lissajous and harmonograph curves animate continuously at 60 FPS.
- [ ] Changing X/Y integer frequency ratios produces mathematically exact knot symmetries.
- [ ] Optional audio preview safely honors mute state and cleans up nodes on close.

title: [Feature/Physics]: Interactive 2D N-Body Orbital Gravity & Planetary Slingshot Mechanics Sandbox
body:
## Problem
Space-themed retro games rely on orbital mechanics and gravitational slingshots, yet ArcadeVerse lacks a dedicated N-body astrodynamics physics sandbox for players to build solar systems and experiment with chaotic multi-star orbits.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/nbody-gravity.css`:
   - Deep-space viewport with HUD controls for Gravitational Constant `G`, Time Scale, Trail Length, Preset Systems (`Binary Star`, `Solar Mini`, `Figure-8 Three-Body`), and Spawn Mass selector.
2. Create modular physics engine `assets/js/nbody-gravity.js`:
   - Implement Velocity-Verlet symplectic integrator (far superior energy conservation over naive Euler for stable elliptical orbits).
   - Apply softening length `epsilon` in `F = G*m1*m2 / (r^2 + eps^2)` to avoid infinite velocity spikes at near-zero distance.
   - Support click-drag launch velocity vector aiming with live dotted trajectory preview and momentum-conserving inelastic collisions (`m_new = m1 + m2`).
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas API, zero external physics engines, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-nbody-gravity.js` validating gravitational force symmetry, momentum conservation on body merge, and Verlet orbital stability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Symplectic Velocity-Verlet integrator maintains stable elliptical orbits without spiraling energy drift.
- [ ] Click-drag spawns planets with initial tangential velocity vector preview.
- [ ] Colliding bodies merge cleanly while conserving linear momentum.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-nbody-gravity.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected files remain untouched.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Procedural 2D L-System Fractal Botanical & Recursive Growth Studio

## Architectural Scope & Requirements

2. Create modular grammar & turtle engine `assets/js/lsystem-studio.js`:
   - Implement string-rewriting engine `expandAxiom(axiom, rules, iterations)` with strict max-string-length safety cap (preventing exponential browser memory exhaustion).
   - Implement stack-based 2D Canvas Turtle interpreter (`F`, `+`, `-`, `[` push transform, `]` pop transform) with depth-colored stroke tapering.
   - Support optional animated progressive growth reveal and gentle sinusoidal wind sway.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas, zero dependencies, zero emojis.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Interactive Web Audio Euclidean Rhythm Sequencer & Circular Beat Visualizer
body:
## Problem
Euclidean rhythms (computed via Bjorklund's algorithm) evenly distribute `k` active beats across `n` steps, mathematically generating famous world and electronic rhythms automatically. ArcadeVerse lacks an interactive algorithmic rhythm explorer combining circular geometry and Web Audio synthesis.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/euclidean-rhythm.css`:
   - Multi-ring circular canvas visualizer paired with 3–4 track controls: Steps `n` (`2`–`16`), Pulses `k` (`0`–`n`), Rotation Offset `r`, BPM, and Track Mute.
2. Create modular rhythm & audio engine `assets/js/euclidean-rhythm.js`:
   - Implement pure Bjorklund / Bresenham Euclidean step distributor `generateEuclideanPattern(steps, pulses, rotation)`.
   - Render concentric glowing geometric polygons connecting active beats on an HTML5 Canvas rotating playhead ring.
   - Trigger Web Audio synthesized percussive voices cleanly synchronized via lookahead scheduling.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas/Web Audio API, zero external packages, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-euclidean-rhythm.js` validating canonical Euclidean rhythms (`E(3,8)` Cuban tresillo `[1,0,0,1,0,0,1,0]`, `E(5,8)` cinquillo, rotation shifting, and `k > n` clamping).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bjorklund algorithm generates exact canonical Euclidean patterns and renders corresponding geometric polygons.
- [ ] Rotating or adjusting pulse counts morphs both the live polygon and rhythmic audio in real-time.
- [ ] Lookahead scheduling keeps multi-track polyrhythms tightly locked.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-euclidean-rhythm.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected files remain untouched.

title: [Feature/VFX]: Interactive 2D Navier-Stokes Incompressible Smoke & Dye Fluid Simulation Canvas
body:
## Problem
Interactive smoke plumes and colorful fluid vortices driven by cursor momentum deliver AAA-grade visual polish in modern web showcases, yet ArcadeVerse lacks a real-time 2D incompressible fluid solver.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/fluid-smoke-canvas.css`:
   - Interactive fluid canvas with controls for Velocity Dissipation, Dye Dissipation, Vorticity Confinement strength, Splat Radius, and Color Cycle mode.
2. Create modular fluid solver `assets/js/fluid-smoke-canvas.js`:
   - Implement real-time 2D grid-based Navier-Stokes solver using `Float32Array` velocity (`u`, `v`), pressure, divergence, and RGB dye grids (Jos Stam "Stable Fluids" method).
   - Run Jacobi iterative pressure projection (`15`–`20` iterations) and semi-Lagrangian bilinear backtrace advection with zero NaN blowup.
   - Inject glowing multi-hued dye splats and directional velocity forces smoothly along mouse/touch drag vectors.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas `ImageData` (zero WebGL shader dependencies required, works everywhere), zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-fluid-smoke-canvas.js` testing divergence-free projection reduction, boundary reflection conditions, and advection stability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Mouse/touch dragging swirls vibrant smoke vortices across the canvas smoothly.
- [ ] Solver remains unconditionally stable without NaN explosions under rapid cursor movement.
- [ ] Parameter sliders tune viscosity, dissipation, and vorticity in real-time.
- [ ] Standalone test `scripts/test-fluid-smoke-canvas.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected files remain untouched.

title: [Feature/Tools]: Interactive Pixel-Art Sprite Editor & CSS Box-Shadow Exporter
body:
## Problem
Game contributors building new retro titles or custom UI badges in ArcadeVerse currently need external software to draw 16x16 or 32x32 pixel sprites and convert them into lightweight inline PNGs or zero-asset CSS `box-shadow` pixel art.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/pixel-sprite-editor.css`:
   - Studio grid canvas (`16x16` / `32x32` toggle), live 1:1 preview thumbnail, retro 16-color swatch palette + hex picker, tool buttons (Pencil, Eraser, Flood Fill, Eyedropper, Mirror X), Undo/Redo buttons, and Export modal.
2. Create modular editor engine `assets/js/pixel-sprite-editor.js`:
   - Maintain immutable history stack (up to 30 undo/redo snapshots) for grid pixel buffer.
   - Implement iterative BFS/DFS scanline flood-fill avoiding stack overflow.
   - Implement exporters:
     - Clean PNG data URL download via offscreen canvas.
     - Valid pure CSS `box-shadow` string exporter omitting transparent cells for optimal CSS output size.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/HTML5 Canvas/CSS3, zero external packages, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-pixel-sprite-editor.js` validating flood-fill region boundaries, mirror symmetry coordinates, undo/redo stack integrity, and CSS `box-shadow` string syntax.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Contributors can paint, erase, flood-fill, mirror, and undo/redo sprites cleanly on 16x16 or 32x32 grids.
- [ ] Export generates valid downloadable PNG files and compact copyable CSS `box-shadow` code.
- [ ] Live preview mirrors edits instantaneously.
- [ ] Automated test `scripts/test-pixel-sprite-editor.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected core files remain untouched.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Procedural Web Audio Additive Harmonic Organ & Drawbar Synthesizer Studio
body:
## Problem
Additive synthesis constructs rich organ, pipe, and glassy sci-fi timbres by summing multiple harmonic sine partials at exact integer and sub-octave ratios, giving audio enthusiasts a completely different synthesis paradigm from subtractive or FM synths.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/additive-organ-synth.css`:
   - Classic 9-drawbar vertical slider console (`16'`, `5 1/3'`, `8'`, `4'`, `2 2/3'`, `2'`, `1 3/5'`, `1 1/3'`, `1'`) with rotary Leslie vibrato speed toggle and preset tonewheel buttons (`Jazz Organ`, `Cathedral Pipe`, `Crystal Bell`, `Retro Arcade Lead`).
2. Create modular additive audio engine `assets/js/additive-organ-synth.js`:
   - Build Web Audio `PeriodicWave` (using real/imag Fourier harmonic arrays computed directly from drawbar levels `0`–`8`) for ultra-clean polyphonic harmonic playback with minimal CPU overhead.
   - Add optional LFO vibrato modulation and playable 1.5-octave on-screen + keyboard piano keys.
   - Render live Fourier spectrum bar graph showing active harmonic partial amplitudes.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API, zero dependencies, zero emojis.
4. Add unit test `scripts/test-additive-organ-synth.js` verifying harmonic frequency ratio array mapping, `PeriodicWave` Fourier coefficient normalization, and preset loading.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Adjusting drawbars dynamically shapes `PeriodicWave` harmonics and live spectrum bar display.
- [ ] Multiple keys can be played polyphonically via mouse or keyboard without clipping distortion.
- [ ] Leslie vibrato toggle modulates pitch/phase smoothly.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-additive-organ-synth.js` passes under `node`.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Procedural 2D Wave Function Collapse Constraint Tilemap Generator
body:
## Problem
Wave Function Collapse (WFC) is one of the most popular modern procedural level generation algorithms for retro tile-based dungeons, islands, and circuits, yet ArcadeVerse lacks an interactive visual WFC sandbox for players and game developers.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create isolated stylesheet `assets/css/wfc-tilemap-generator.css`:
   - Grid canvas frame displaying tiles collapsing step-by-step alongside entropy counts on uncollapsed cells.
   - Controls for Grid Size (`8x8`, `12x12`, `16x16`), Tileset (`Circuit Board`, `Island Archipelago`, `Dungeon Maze`), Generation Speed (`Step`, `Animated`, `Instant`), Seed input, and Backtrack/Reset button.
2. Create modular WFC solver `assets/js/wfc-tilemap-generator.js`:
   - Implement explicit socket/edge adjacency constraints across 4 cardinal directions (`N`, `E`, `S`, `W`).
   - Implement minimum-entropy cell selection (with deterministic seeded PRNG tie-breaking), weighted collapse, and BFS constraint propagation queue.
   - Handle rare contradiction dead-ends gracefully via automatic local rollback or clean retry without infinite loops.
3. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas/SVG tiles, zero external image sheets, zero emojis.
4. Add automated unit test `scripts/test-wfc-tilemap-generator.js` validating seeded determinism, socket compatibility symmetry, entropy reduction, and full-grid valid constraint completion.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] WFC solver animates cell collapse from highest certainty (lowest entropy) to complete seamless tilemaps.
- [ ] Every generated neighbor pair satisfies strict edge socket constraints with zero mismatched borders.
- [ ] Same seed consistently produces identical maps; contradictions recover cleanly without hanging.
- [ ] Standalone test `scripts/test-wfc-tilemap-generator.js` passes under `node`.
- [ ] Protected core files remain untouched.
